d:
Chhath manane ke lie desh ke alag-alag hisson men rah rahe bihar ke saikron log vapas apne rajy laut rahe hain. har sal chhath ke dauran relve ki sevaon ko lekar saval uthte rahe hain. patna jankshan par maujud yatriyon se bibisi ne bat ki aur unki mushkilen janin.
Riport: prerna
Shut: saptarishi
Edit: dipak jasrotiya
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
